fact: The Gavi Zero-Dose Learning Hub's assessment of November 2024 states that all health facilities offering routine immunisation provide monthly reports to LGA offices, where the reports are entered manually into DHIS2, and that LGA M&E officers cannot obtain complete data because PHC personnel fail to fill out the health management information system paper tools.
title: Assessment of the Political Economy Context Surrounding Evidence Use for Zero-Dose Programming and Policies in Nigeria
